Name: AutoGate
Author: Teban100
Description:
[b]AutoGate[/b] opens gates when you walk up to them, and closes them when you walk away.

No more frustrating clicking when you try to pass through gates with your horse!

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/StephenKairos/Teban100-StardewMods/master/AutoGate/docs/screenshot.gif[/img]

[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url]﻿.
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]Use[/size][/b]
Just walk/ride up to any gate in-game and it'll open automatically, and close behind you![b]
[/b]
[b][size=5]Compatibility[/size][/b]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.
